name: Wanna Be Happy? Reality
overview: A team of experts — doctors, psychologists, and sexologists — have just three days to save the participants' families, strengthen their marriages, and help their relationships. The couple will try the most unexpected, sensual and daring practices to get to know themselves and their partner better, regain the joy of love and sex, and find their own formula for happiness. All that is required from the participants is maximum frankness.
